reason: Vendor the task-gate simplicity check authored and proven in the myclaw client repo. The plan gate already hunts a simpler shape and fails over-built plans, and constitution 09-agent-conduct section 2 names the plan grill as where that happens, but the task gate has no simplicity check at all. Observed: a real task grill returned twelve findings on a wide contract without once asking whether the task was over-built, so the orchestrator raised the split question by hand -- exactly the judgement a gate exists to not depend on. No codex CLI on this session's PATH, so delegation is unavailable and this is the bounded exception.
